verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports confirm Ollama ships a native GUI app for macOS and Windows for chatting with local models, and one user says multimodal input and Markdown rendering work as expected (comm-16, comm-18). The quickstart's macOS app reference corroborates that a desktop app exists (docs-16). Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the chat GUI, Linux support for the app, and the ability to connect the GUI to a remote Ollama instance.
